What this log establishes

It records development instructions and builder-reported outcomes. Technical assertions and DOM-stub checks are distinct from browser visual QA. The prompt records do not establish real customer use, clinical validity, student or team rehearsals, a class vote, payments or willingness to pay. Private source documents and attachments are not included here.

The source log files remain unchanged. No additional prompts, participant identities or observations have been invented. The exact source text in the JSON download allows each original record to be recovered without relying on the display summary.
